group_entry.grouping_reason: These five witnesses are the loop-entry, loop-step, return, and initial list-splitting obligations of one direct linked-list proof. They share xizi_sllseg/xizi_sll_to_target decomposition and composition lemmas. Keeping them together avoids an artificial dependency while remaining below max_witnesses_per_group = 12; combining the separate wand/spec-derivation family would mix materially different proof structure.

group_entry.natural_language_proof_pattern: Normalize generated pure equalities, select the usable branch, instantiate the loop decomposition, and transform only the xizi_sllseg/xizi_sll_to_target spatial spine with existing common-library lemmas.
proving_hints: entail_wit_1: choose the right disjunct and instantiate l1b and l0 with l0_2; the spatial antecedent is unchanged and PreH1 supplies the list equality.

entail_wit_2: choose the right disjunct, instantiate l1a with l1a_2 ++ [node], l1b with l0_3, and l0 with l0_2; build the extra one-node segment with xizi_sllseg_len1 and compose it with xizi_sllseg_sllseg.

return_wit_1: rewrite next = linklist_node_pre, use xizi_sll_to_target_same to obtain l1b = nil, compose the retained prefix and suffix, then use xizi_sll_head_from_cons; preserve the removed node's points-to cell.
return_wit_2: rewrite next = 0 and apply xizi_sll_to_target_zero_nonzero using linklist_node_pre <> 0; ex falso closes the return alternative.

which_implies_wit_1: normalize l_strong_spec = l1_strong_spec ++ linklist_node :: l2_strong_spec and apply xizi_sll_head_split_target; its outputs exactly supply target non-nullness, head-target inequality, target cell, prefix-to-target, and suffix xizi_sll.
